decisions.reason: The DCDC1 load-coverage attribute names INA219 as the powered current monitor; accepting INA3221 as its replacement necessarily changes that device reference.

value_updates.normal_operation_role: Primary source for the ESP32-S3, INA3221, downstream 3.3V sensors, I2C display, TTP223, and AM312 when the power board is connected

decisions.reason: Changing the rail-current monitor from INA219 to INA3221 does not change the 5V boost converter, enable control, output rating, or powered loads.
The AXP2101 remains the normal-operation power source for all system loads regardless of which current-monitor device is used.
The current-monitor substitution does not affect the battery NTC connector, thermal-protection function, or controller.
The current-monitor substitution does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or DW01A protection semantics.
The battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, and unresolved pin order are independent of the rail-current monitor selection.
The selected current-monitor device does not change the charge-status LED interface or its component values.

The standalone USB supply's load-coverage attribute explicitly names INA219; replacing that current monitor necessarily updates the named powered device while leaving the rest of the rail coverage unchanged.

value_updates.powered_rail: complete 3.3V rail including the ESP32-S3, INA3221, I2C sensors, I2C display, TTP223, and AM312 PIR

decisions.reason: The addressable LEDs' 5V supply, level shifting, data interface, and standby power control remain unchanged by the current-monitor substitution.
INA219 appears only in historical explanatory context; the candidate's current connector, pinout, board-chain, and power-distribution state does not depend on the monitor model.
The monitor model was mentioned historically alongside the main-board contents but does not affect the selected ESP32-S3 module or part number.
The current-monitor substitution does not alter the USB data lines or the USB-C programming-port role.
